name: Homes England funds and interventions collection
fact: Homes England's current collection links NHDF, National Housing Bank, affordable housing, land and remediation interventions.
gate: Programme index is discovery evidence only.

name: National Housing Bank July 2026 regeneration deals
fact: Published 9 July 2026; National Housing Bank announced £35m agreements across Salford, Bromley and Ludlow, including a £14m infrastructure loan linked to up to 1,900 Middlewood Locks homes.
gate: Named financing is project-level context, not evidence for unrelated parcels.

name: SP Manweb heat-map transition
fact: SP Energy Networks says the webpage heat map is based on October 2025 data and no longer updated; latest data has moved to its Open Data Portal and the page remains until 3 August 2026.
gate: Do not use the legacy map as current headroom; account-gated latest values are not inferred.

name: SPEN ConnectMore capacity heatmap transcript
fact: ConnectMore models LV and HV capacity from asset loading versus rating and uses traffic-light indications; LV covers up to 150kVA and HV examples cover 250-2500kVA.
gate: Modelled indication is not a formal connection offer or guaranteed capacity.

name: SP Energy Networks Network Development Plan
fact: NDP publishes intervention plans and forecast demand and generation headroom at primary substations, with annual values for the first decade and five-year intervals thereafter to 2050.
gate: Forecast headroom includes assumptions and interventions and is not contractual connection capacity.

name: SPEN planning and network development
fact: SPEN explains forecasting, network assessment, flexibility and reinforcement choices used to plan future capacity.
gate: Planning forecasts are not a reservation or connection offer.

name: SP Energy Networks Long Term Development Statement
fact: Current LTDS page publishes network data, short-term forecast changes and a 2026 mid-year connection-activity update.
gate: LTDS enables initial assessment only and does not replace a project-specific connection study.

name: SP Energy Networks data and information sharing
fact: SPEN groups LTDS, NDP and DFES datasets as short-, medium- and long-term network planning information.
gate: Dataset availability does not establish exact project headroom.

name: SP Electricity North West Network Development Plan 2026
fact: SP Electricity North West publishes its final 2026 NDP and methodology dated 30 April 2026, showing where connections may be suitable and capacity interventions over ten years.
gate: NDP is forward planning and does not reserve capacity.

name: SP Electricity North West Heatmap Tool
fact: Heatmap download is dated 30 June 2026; the operator says actual supply changes and new connections require detailed assessment, approval and charges.
gate: Heatmap is screening evidence only, not a connection offer.

name: SP Electricity North West network data
fact: Network-data page exposes LTDS, Embedded Capacity Register and asset viewer for initial assessment of network capabilities.
gate: Initial network information is not project-specific capacity approval.

name: SP Electricity North West releasing capacity
fact: Current page links asset viewer, heat map, open-data portal and pre-application support for planning connections.
gate: Support tools do not reserve or guarantee capacity.

name: SP Electricity North West digital service catalogue
fact: Digital catalogue states the heatmap helps developers assess capacity that might be available at primary substations and bulk supply points.
gate: Might-be-available capacity is indicative and must not be treated as firm headroom.

name: National Grid Electricity Distribution NDP 2026
fact: Latest NGED Network Development Plans were published 1 May 2026 and cover future demand growth, constraints and interventions over roughly five to ten years.
gate: NDP outputs are planning forecasts, not connection offers.

name: SSEN SEPD Long Term Development Statement dataset
fact: SSEN publishes May 2026 SEPD LTDS capacity heatmap resources in GeoJSON, JSON and KML alongside CIM data.
gate: Published heatmap remains planning evidence and does not create a connection entitlement.

name: SSEN connections useful documents
fact: SSEN library lists multiple connection-offer guidance documents and terms updated 14 July 2026, including land rights, curtailment, reinforcement and project programming.
gate: Guidance and terms do not prove a project has an accepted offer.

name: BR00005 Stonebridge Primary School Annexe
fact: Brent authoritative entry dated 10 April 2026 records 0.6ha, public ownership, full permission and 67 dwellings.
gate: Permissioned register status still requires live completion, title and canonical geometry checks before promotion.

name: BR00008 Olympic Office Centre
fact: Brent authoritative entry dated 10 April 2026 records 0.49ha, deliverable, full permission and 253 dwellings.
gate: Permission may be partly implemented, varied or completed; live planning and geometry checks remain required.

name: BR00026 OK Club
fact: Brent authoritative record has entry date 2 April 2026 but an end date of 2 November 2019, with a historic full permission for five flats.
gate: End-dated record is a rejection/data-quality control and must not be treated as a current development candidate.

name: BR00064 Former Unisys and Bridge Park Centre
fact: Brent record is deliverable, mixed ownership, 505 dwellings and not-permissioned, but its entry date is 13 December 2019.
gate: Older entry requires current register, allocation and ownership verification before any candidate use.

name: BR00099 Northfield Industrial Estate
fact: Brent current search result records a 10 April 2026 entry, 6.01ha, deliverable, outline permission and 2,426 dwellings for the remaining allocation area.
gate: Large capacity and permission status require current phase/completion and exact geometry reconciliation.

name: BR00175 462-466 High Road Wembley
fact: Brent authoritative entry dated 10 April 2026 records 0.05ha, deliverable, full permission and eight dwellings.
gate: Small permissioned site still needs current completion and exact parcel checks.

name: BR00180 public-owned Wembley site
fact: Brent search result records public ownership, full permission and 456 dwellings for BR00180 with 2026 register data.
gate: Live completion, legal control and exact parcel relation remain required.

name: BR00183 College of North West London Wembley
fact: Authoritative Brent record lists 0.24ha, 155 dwellings and not-permissioned with a local-plan allocation, but the entity entry date is 4 March 2022.
gate: Allocation and capacity are not consent; older entity date requires current authority verification.

name: BR00187 Wembley Park Station and adjacent land
fact: Brent search result records 0.33ha, 60 dwellings, private ownership and not-permissioned, with Local Plan allocation BCSA19.
gate: Not-permissioned status means no consent is inferred; exact allocation and current availability remain required.

name: BR00190 Staples Corner Growth Area
fact: Brent authoritative entry dated 10 March 2026 records 42.67ha, 1,989 dwellings and not-permissioned; notes subtract completed development from capacity.
gate: Growth-area capacity is plan/register evidence, not consent; phase, ownership and exact parcel geometry remain required.
